about: The island as a whole (Sài Gòn mini, layout v8), shared by the game (src/game/mapInfo.ts) and the server (content/map.go). Points are Blender XY in metres (three.js x = X, z = -Y). spawn is where a player without an archetype starts, on the square in front of Chợ Bến Thành; sea_level is the height (Blender Z) the sea is drawn at, which the game also treats as the water a body cannot wade into; island_center is where the gulls and clouds circle; bounds [x0, y0, x1, y1] frame the island and its beach (the server's load bots and tests stay inside it). Walls, floors and steps are the map's own shapes: the game collides with the GLB itself (src/game/collider.ts).
